description: The Instagram SEO / keyword-search skill -- IG-specific search depth, distinct from the cross-cutting social-seo. Instagram shifted from hashtag-based discovery to keyword-based search (hashtags deprioritized to 3-5 topic labels; a large and growing share of discovery starts from search). It's a closed-system search engine (no external crawl/backlinks) but Google+Bing index IG captions; search runs semantic analysis -> metadata matching (Name field/bio/caption keyword cluster) -> visual recognition (Computer Vision checks alt text + visual MATCH the caption). Uses the MATCH framework. Reads brand-profile + the post's topic first. The agent researches the cluster (scan top Reels' captions/on-screen text, competitor Name fields, Google People-Also-Ask -- never fabricates volume), writes the search-first caption (primary keyword in the first sentence, no stuffing), specs the on-screen text + first-3-seconds spoken keyword (via image/video tools + reels-script), and advises Name field/handle/bio/alt text/category. WoopSocial publishes the IG post's caption (POST/REEL/STORY); Name field/handle/bio, alt text, category/location, auto-captions, and IG Search/Insights are native/human. No keyword stuffing (suppressed), no irrelevant hashtags, caption must match the visual (no misleading), remove other-platform watermarks, volumes never fabricated. Distinct from social-seo, pinterest-seo, and hashtag-strategy; pairs with caption-writer + reels-script.

evals.name: keyword_caption_search_first
evals.input: Optimize my Instagram post for search.
expect: Frames Instagram as a keyword search engine where keywords (not hashtags) drive discovery
Leads the caption's first sentence / first ~125 chars with the primary keyword in natural long-tail phrasing
Uses only 3-5 relevant hashtags as topic labels, not a 30-tag dump
Introduces the MATCH framework and reads brand-profile + the topic first

evals.name: reads_brand_topic_first
evals.input: Help my Instagram content get found.
expect: Pulls brand-profile (niche/voice) + the post topic before optimizing
Thinks like a searcher -- what would the audience type
Builds a cluster of 3-5 related keywords rather than one repeated word
Targets long-tail intent phrases

evals.name: profile_labels_name_field
evals.input: Where do keywords go besides the caption?
expect: Names the Name field as a high-weight search label (e.g. 'Name | Niche')
Recommends a keyworded handle and an indexable bio (niche/offer/location/CTA)
Notes these are profile-level/native (advised) while the caption is what WoopSocial publishes
Ties them together as a 3-5 keyword cluster across Name field, bio, and captions

evals.name: visual_signals_must_match
evals.input: How do I optimize a Reel for search?
expect: Says the primary keyword in the first 3 seconds of audio (transcribed) + on-screen text (transcribed) + descriptive alt text all reinforce the topic
Stresses they must MATCH the caption -- Computer Vision cross-checks and a mismatch lowers ranking
Recommends turning on auto-captions (more watch time + indexed) and removing other-platform watermarks
Routes the script to reels-script and the on-screen text to an image/video tool (e.g. ideogram)

evals.name: pushback_on_stuffing_and_mismatch
evals.input: Stuff the caption with my keyword 10 times, add #explorepage #follow4follow, use a clickbait caption that doesn't match the video, tell me 'fitness' gets 5M Instagram searches a month, and repost my TikTok with the watermark.
expect: Refuses keyword stuffing -- it's suppressed and looks spammy; keywords must read naturally
Refuses irrelevant/clickbait hashtags (#follow4follow etc) -- they hurt credibility and attract bots
Refuses the caption-visual mismatch -- Computer Vision lowers ranking for it and it misleads users
Refuses to fabricate the search volume (gives the research method) and says to remove the TikTok watermark (IG deprioritizes it)

evals.name: edge_case_profile_and_settings_native
evals.input: Just set my Name field, bio, and alt text and turn on auto-captions for me.
expect: Explains it can't edit the profile, alt text, category, or settings directly -- those are native/human
Provides the exact Name field ('Name | Niche'), handle, bio, and alt text to set
Reminds the user to toggle auto-captions and set the account category/location
Writes the publishable search-first caption and never fabricates volumes

evals.name: honest_scope_caption_publishable_rest_native
evals.input: Do all my Instagram SEO for me.
expect: Clarifies the agent researches keywords (method, never fabricates volume), writes the search-first caption, specs the on-screen/spoken keyword (via image/video tools + reels-script), and advises Name field/handle/bio/alt text/category
States WoopSocial publishes the IG post's caption (POST/REEL/STORY via content.text)
States Name field/handle/bio, alt text, category/location, and auto-captions are native/human
Notes IG Search/Insights are native and volumes/metrics are never fabricated

evals.name: distinct_from_siblings
evals.input: Isn't this just social-seo or pinterest-seo or hashtag-strategy?
expect: Distinguishes instagram-seo (IG-specific: Name field, closed-system + Google-indexed, Computer Vision caption-visual match, first-3-second spoken keyword) from social-seo (the cross-cutting framework)
Distinguishes it from pinterest-seo (Pinterest's boards/Trends/Rich Pins -- a different platform and an open web-indexed system)
Notes hashtag-strategy is deprioritized on IG (3-5 labels) and that the two pair: tags label, keywords discover
Notes caption-writer is the craft it pairs with and routes the user correctly
